about: Where pictures are set: per country or territory (ISO 3166-1 alpha-2, or ISO 3166-2 for a part kept apart), its English name, other names a reader may give, and the heritages (person.ethnicity values) common there with their shares of its people. Shares need not sum to 1: the rest is spread by the global prior. A person's descent is drawn from w * this mix + (1 - w) * the global prior (places.py).

AE.name: United Arab Emirates
AE.notes: Emiratis, about a tenth of residents, are drawn as Saudi; the share follows residents, so most people drawn are South Asian.

AF.name: Afghanistan
AF.notes: Hazaras have no listed heritage: drawn as Afghan.

AG.name: Antigua and Barbuda
AG.notes: Afro-Caribbean people of the smaller islands are drawn as Jamaican, the nearest listed look.

AL.name: Albania
AL.notes: Albanians have no listed heritage: drawn as Greek.

AU.name: Australia
AU.notes: Anglo-Australians are drawn as English, Irish and Scottish.

AW.name: Aruba
AW.notes: Arubans are drawn as Venezuelan, the nearest mixed look.

AZ.name: Azerbaijan
AZ.notes: Azerbaijanis have no listed heritage: drawn as Iranian and Turkish.

BA.name: Bosnia and Herzegovina
BA.notes: No South Slavic heritage is listed: Serbs, Croats, Bosniaks, Slovenes and Montenegrins are drawn as the nearest Romanian, Greek, Ukrainian and Polish looks.

BB.name: Barbados
BB.notes: Afro-Caribbean people of the smaller islands are drawn as Jamaican, the nearest listed look.

BE.name: Belgium
BE.notes: Flemish are drawn as Dutch and Walloons as French.

BF.name: Burkina Faso
BF.notes: West Africans have only Nigerian, Ghanaian and Senegalese listed: the Sahel and the Atlantic coast are drawn as Senegalese, the Gulf of Guinea as Ghanaian and Nigerian.

BG.name: Bulgaria
BG.notes: Bulgarians have no listed heritage: drawn as Romanian and Greek. Roma are a visible minority here and have no listed heritage; left to the global remainder.

BI.name: Burundi
BI.notes: Burundians are drawn as Ugandan and Congolese.

BJ.name: Benin
BJ.notes: West Africans have only Nigerian, Ghanaian and Senegalese listed: the Sahel and the Atlantic coast are drawn as Senegalese, the Gulf of Guinea as Ghanaian and Nigerian.

BM.name: Bermuda
BM.notes: Afro-Caribbean people of the smaller islands are drawn as Jamaican, the nearest listed look.

BS.name: Bahamas
BS.notes: Afro-Caribbean people of the smaller islands are drawn as Jamaican, the nearest listed look.

BT.name: Bhutan
BT.notes: Ngalop Bhutanese are drawn as Tibetan, Lhotshampa as Nepali.

BW.name: Botswana
BW.notes: Batswana are drawn as South African.

BY.name: Belarus
BY.notes: Belarusians are drawn as Russian, Polish and Ukrainian.

BZ.name: Belize
BZ.notes: Mestizo Belizeans are drawn as Mexican, Kriol as Jamaican, Maya as Guatemalan, Mennonites as German.

CA.name: Canada
CA.notes: Québécois are drawn as French. First Nations have no listed heritage besides Navajo, Cherokee and Inuit; left to the global remainder rather than naming the wrong nation.

CD.name: Democratic Republic of the Congo
CD.notes: A bare "Congo" is read as the larger country, the DRC; the heritage is the same for both.

CF.name: Central African Republic
CF.notes: Central and southern Bantu peoples are drawn as the nearest listed neighbors.

CH.name: Switzerland
CH.notes: Swiss are drawn as German, French and Italian by language region; Kosovars and other Balkan residents left to the remainder.

CI.name: Côte d'Ivoire
CI.notes: West Africans have only Nigerian, Ghanaian and Senegalese listed: the Sahel and the Atlantic coast are drawn as Senegalese, the Gulf of Guinea as Ghanaian and Nigerian.

CK.name: Cook Islands
CK.notes: Cook Islands Māori are drawn as Māori.

CM.name: Cameroon
CM.notes: Cameroonians are drawn as Nigerian (west and north) and Congolese (south).

CN.name: China
CN.notes: Uyghurs are drawn as Uzbek; Zhuang, Hui and other minorities as Chinese.

CR.name: Costa Rica
CR.notes: Costa Ricans are drawn as Colombian and Mexican; Afro-Costa Ricans as Jamaican.

CV.name: Cabo Verde
CV.notes: Cape Verdeans are drawn as Brazilian, the nearest mixed African and Portuguese look.

CY.name: Cyprus
CY.notes: Greek Cypriots are drawn as Greek, Turkish Cypriots as Turkish.

CZ.name: Czechia
CZ.notes: Czechs are drawn as Polish and German. Roma are a visible minority here and have no listed heritage; left to the global remainder.

DJ.name: Djibouti
DJ.notes: The Afar are drawn as Ethiopian and Eritrean.

DM.name: Dominica
DM.notes: Afro-Caribbean people of the smaller islands are drawn as Jamaican, the nearest listed look.

DZ.name: Algeria
DZ.notes: Kabyle and other Amazigh Algerians are drawn as Algerian.

EE.name: Estonia
EE.notes: Estonians are drawn as Finnish (both Finnic).

ES.name: Spain
ES.notes: Catalans, Basques and Galicians are drawn as Spanish.

FI.name: Finland
FI.notes: Swedish-speaking Finns are drawn as Swedish; the Sámi have no listed heritage.

FM.name: Micronesia
FM.notes: Micronesians have no listed heritage: drawn as the nearest Polynesian and Filipino looks.

FR.name: France
FR.notes: French Antilleans have no listed heritage: drawn as Haitian.

GA.name: Gabon
GA.notes: Central and southern Bantu peoples are drawn as the nearest listed neighbors.

GB.name: United Kingdom
aliases: United Kingdom of Great Britain and Northern Ireland
GB.notes: Black British of Caribbean heritage are drawn as Jamaican.

GB-NIR.name: Northern Ireland
GB-NIR.notes: Ulster Protestants of Scottish descent are mostly drawn as Irish; the look is the same family.

GD.name: Grenada
GD.notes: Afro-Caribbean people of the smaller islands are drawn as Jamaican, the nearest listed look.

GE.name: Georgia
GE.notes: Azerbaijanis in Georgia are drawn as Turkish and Iranian. The name is shared with a US state; the reader names countries, so it means the country.

GF.name: French Guiana
GF.notes: Guianese Creoles are drawn as Jamaican and Haitian.

GM.name: Gambia
GM.notes: West Africans have only Nigerian, Ghanaian and Senegalese listed: the Sahel and the Atlantic coast are drawn as Senegalese, the Gulf of Guinea as Ghanaian and Nigerian.

GN.name: Guinea
GN.notes: West Africans have only Nigerian, Ghanaian and Senegalese listed: the Sahel and the Atlantic coast are drawn as Senegalese, the Gulf of Guinea as Ghanaian and Nigerian.

GP.name: Guadeloupe
GP.notes: French Antilleans have no listed heritage: drawn as Haitian and Jamaican.

GQ.name: Equatorial Guinea
GQ.notes: The Fang are drawn as Congolese.

GR.name: Greece
GR.notes: Albanians in Greece are drawn as Greek.

GU.name: Guam
GU.notes: Chamorros are drawn as Filipino. Micronesians have no listed heritage: drawn as the nearest Polynesian and Filipino looks.

GW.name: Guinea-Bissau
GW.notes: West Africans have only Nigerian, Ghanaian and Senegalese listed: the Sahel and the Atlantic coast are drawn as Senegalese, the Gulf of Guinea as Ghanaian and Nigerian.

GY.name: Guyana
GY.notes: Afro-Guyanese are drawn as Jamaican; Indigenous Guyanese have no listed heritage.

HN.name: Honduras
HN.notes: Hondurans have no listed heritage: drawn as Salvadoran and Guatemalan; Garifuna as Jamaican.

HR.name: Croatia
HR.notes: No South Slavic heritage is listed: Serbs, Croats, Bosniaks, Slovenes and Montenegrins are drawn as the nearest Romanian, Greek, Ukrainian and Polish looks.

HU.name: Hungary
HU.notes: Hungarians have no listed heritage: drawn as Polish, German and Romanian. Roma are a visible minority here and have no listed heritage; left to the global remainder.

ID.name: Indonesia
ID.notes: Papuans are drawn as Papua New Guinean.

IL.name: Israel
IL.notes: The heritage list has no Jewish heritage: Ashkenazi Jews are drawn as Russian, Polish, Ukrainian, Romanian and German; Mizrahi and Sephardi Jews as Moroccan, Iraqi, Iranian, Yemeni, Tunisian and Lebanese; Beta Israel as Ethiopian. Arab citizens are drawn as Palestinian.

IN.name: India
IN.notes: Northeast Indians (Naga, Mizo, Assamese) have no listed heritage: a few drawn as Nepali.

IQ.name: Iraq
IQ.notes: Iraqi Turkmen are drawn as Turkish.

IR.name: Iran
IR.notes: Azerbaijanis, about a sixth of Iran, are drawn as Turkish; Baloch and Lurs as Iranian.

IS.name: Iceland
IS.notes: Icelanders are drawn as Norwegian, the nearest listed look.

IT.name: Italy
IT.notes: Albanians in Italy have no listed heritage.

JO.name: Jordan
JO.notes: East Bank Jordanians are drawn as Palestinian and Saudi (Bedouin).

JP.name: Japan
JP.notes: The Ainu and Ryukyuans are drawn as Japanese.

KH.name: Cambodia
KH.notes: The Cham are drawn as Malay.

KI.name: Kiribati
KI.notes: Micronesians have no listed heritage: drawn as the nearest Polynesian and Filipino looks.

KN.name: Saint Kitts and Nevis
KN.notes: Afro-Caribbean people of the smaller islands are drawn as Jamaican, the nearest listed look.

KY.name: Cayman Islands
KY.notes: Afro-Caribbean people of the smaller islands are drawn as Jamaican, the nearest listed look.

LA.name: Laos
LA.notes: Khmu and Hmong have no listed heritage.

LC.name: Saint Lucia
LC.notes: Afro-Caribbean people of the smaller islands are drawn as Jamaican, the nearest listed look.

LR.name: Liberia
LR.notes: West Africans have only Nigerian, Ghanaian and Senegalese listed: the Sahel and the Atlantic coast are drawn as Senegalese, the Gulf of Guinea as Ghanaian and Nigerian.

LT.name: Lithuania
LT.notes: Lithuanians are drawn as Polish, the nearest listed Baltic look.

LU.name: Luxembourg
LU.notes: Luxembourgers are drawn as German and French.

LV.name: Latvia
LV.notes: Latvians are drawn as Polish, the nearest listed Baltic look.

MD.name: Moldova
MD.notes: The Gagauz are drawn as Turkish.

ME.name: Montenegro
ME.notes: No South Slavic heritage is listed: Serbs, Croats, Bosniaks, Slovenes and Montenegrins are drawn as the nearest Romanian, Greek, Ukrainian and Polish looks.

MG.name: Madagascar
MG.notes: The Malagasy have no listed heritage: drawn as Indonesian (highland Merina) and Tanzanian and Kenyan (coastal peoples).

MH.name: Marshall Islands
MH.notes: Micronesians have no listed heritage: drawn as the nearest Polynesian and Filipino looks.

MK.name: North Macedonia
MK.notes: Macedonians and Albanians are drawn as Greek and Romanian.

ML.name: Mali
ML.notes: West Africans have only Nigerian, Ghanaian and Senegalese listed: the Sahel and the Atlantic coast are drawn as Senegalese, the Gulf of Guinea as Ghanaian and Nigerian. Tuareg and Moors are drawn as Moroccan and Algerian.

MM.name: Myanmar
MM.notes: Shan are drawn as Thai, Rohingya as Bangladeshi; Karen, Kachin and Chin as Burmese.

MP.name: Northern Mariana Islands
MP.notes: Chamorros and Carolinians are drawn as Filipino and Samoan.

MQ.name: Martinique
MQ.notes: French Antilleans have no listed heritage: drawn as Haitian and Jamaican.

MR.name: Mauritania
MR.notes: Moors are drawn as Moroccan; Haratin and Black Mauritanians as Senegalese.

MT.name: Malta
MT.notes: Maltese are drawn as Italian, the nearest listed look.

MU.name: Mauritius
MU.notes: Creole Mauritians are drawn as Tanzanian and South African.

MV.name: Maldives
MV.notes: Maldivians are drawn as Sri Lankan.

MW.name: Malawi
MW.notes: Central and southern Bantu peoples are drawn as the nearest listed neighbors.

MX.name: Mexico
MX.notes: Maya, Zapotec and other Indigenous Mexicans are drawn as Mexican.

MY.name: Malaysia
MY.notes: The indigenous peoples of Borneo are drawn as Indonesian and Filipino.

MZ.name: Mozambique
MZ.notes: Central and southern Bantu peoples are drawn as the nearest listed neighbors.

NA.name: Namibia
NA.notes: Ovambo are drawn as Angolan; Herero, Nama, Coloured and Afrikaner Namibians as South African.

NC.name: New Caledonia
NC.notes: Kanak are drawn as Fijian and Papua New Guinean, Wallisians as Samoan.

NE.name: Niger
NE.notes: Hausa are drawn as Nigerian, Zarma and Fula as Senegalese, Tuareg as Algerian.

NI.name: Nicaragua
NI.notes: Nicaraguans are drawn as Salvadoran, Guatemalan and Mexican; Creoles as Jamaican.

NL.name: Netherlands
NL.notes: Surinamese Dutch are drawn as Indian (Hindustani) and Jamaican (Afro-Surinamese); Indo Dutch as Indonesian.

NO.name: Norway
NO.notes: The Sámi have no listed heritage.

NR.name: Nauru
NR.notes: Micronesians have no listed heritage: drawn as the nearest Polynesian and Filipino looks.

NU.name: Niue
NU.notes: Niueans are drawn as Samoan and Tongan.

NZ.name: New Zealand
NZ.notes: Pākehā are drawn as English, Scottish and Irish.

OM.name: Oman
OM.notes: Omanis are drawn as Saudi; Baloch Omanis as Pakistani.

PA.name: Panama
PA.notes: Panamanians are drawn as Colombian; Afro-Panamanians as Jamaican and Dominican; Ngäbe and Guna as Guatemalan.

PF.name: French Polynesia
PF.notes: Tahitians have no listed heritage: drawn as the nearest Polynesian looks.

PK.name: Pakistan
PK.notes: Sindhis and Baloch are drawn as Pakistani.

PT.name: Portugal
PT.notes: Cape Verdeans in Portugal have no listed heritage.

PW.name: Palau
PW.notes: Micronesians have no listed heritage: drawn as the nearest Polynesian and Filipino looks.

PY.name: Paraguay
PY.notes: Paraguayans are drawn as Argentinian and Bolivian; Mennonites as German.

RE.name: Réunion
RE.notes: Réunionese Creoles are drawn as South African.

RO.name: Romania
RO.notes: Hungarians in Romania are drawn as Romanian. Roma are a visible minority here and have no listed heritage; left to the global remainder.

RS.name: Serbia
RS.notes: No South Slavic heritage is listed: Serbs, Croats, Bosniaks, Slovenes and Montenegrins are drawn as the nearest Romanian, Greek, Ukrainian and Polish looks. Roma are a visible minority here and have no listed heritage; left to the global remainder.

RU.name: Russia
RU.notes: Tatars, Bashkirs and the peoples of the Caucasus and Siberia have no listed heritage; Buryats are drawn as Mongolian.

RW.name: Rwanda
RW.notes: Rwandans have no listed heritage: drawn as Ugandan and Congolese.

SB.name: Solomon Islands
SB.notes: Melanesians other than Fijian and Papua New Guinean are drawn as those two.

SC.name: Seychelles
SC.notes: Seychellois Creoles are drawn as South African and Tanzanian.

SI.name: Slovenia
SI.notes: No South Slavic heritage is listed: Serbs, Croats, Bosniaks, Slovenes and Montenegrins are drawn as the nearest Romanian, Greek, Ukrainian and Polish looks.

SK.name: Slovakia
SK.notes: Slovaks are drawn as Polish; Hungarians in Slovakia left to the remainder. Roma are a visible minority here and have no listed heritage; left to the global remainder.

SL.name: Sierra Leone
SL.notes: West Africans have only Nigerian, Ghanaian and Senegalese listed: the Sahel and the Atlantic coast are drawn as Senegalese, the Gulf of Guinea as Ghanaian and Nigerian.

SR.name: Suriname
SR.notes: Creoles and Maroons are drawn as Jamaican, Hindustani as Indian, Javanese as Indonesian.

SS.name: South Sudan
SS.notes: Dinka, Nuer and other South Sudanese are drawn as Sudanese.

TC.name: Turks and Caicos Islands
TC.notes: Afro-Caribbean people of the smaller islands are drawn as Jamaican, the nearest listed look.

TD.name: Chad
TD.notes: Chadian Arabs are drawn as Sudanese, Sara as Congolese, Kanembu as Nigerian.

TG.name: Togo
TG.notes: West Africans have only Nigerian, Ghanaian and Senegalese listed: the Sahel and the Atlantic coast are drawn as Senegalese, the Gulf of Guinea as Ghanaian and Nigerian.

TL.name: Timor-Leste
TL.notes: Timorese are drawn as Indonesian and Papua New Guinean.

TT.name: Trinidad and Tobago
TT.notes: Afro-Trinidadians are drawn as Jamaican; mixed Trinidadians left to the remainder.

TV.name: Tuvalu
TV.notes: Tuvaluans are drawn as Samoan and Tongan.

TW.name: Taiwan
TW.notes: Indigenous Formosans are drawn as Filipino, the nearest Austronesian look.

UA.name: Ukraine
UA.notes: Crimean Tatars have no listed heritage.

US.name: United States
US.notes: White Americans have no heritage of their own: drawn as their largest ancestries (German, Irish, English, Italian and others). First Nations have no listed heritage besides Navajo, Cherokee and Inuit; left to the global remainder rather than naming the wrong nation.

US-HI.name: Hawaii
US-HI.notes: A US state kept apart because it looks nothing like the mainland; the reader only names it when the prompt is set there.

VC.name: Saint Vincent and the Grenadines
VC.notes: Afro-Caribbean people of the smaller islands are drawn as Jamaican, the nearest listed look.

VI.name: U.S. Virgin Islands
VI.notes: Afro-Caribbean people of the smaller islands are drawn as Jamaican, the nearest listed look.

VN.name: Vietnam
VN.notes: Tay, Thai and other upland peoples are drawn as Thai and Lao; the Hmong have no listed heritage.

VU.name: Vanuatu
VU.notes: Melanesians other than Fijian and Papua New Guinean are drawn as those two.

XK.name: Kosovo
XK.notes: Albanians are drawn as Greek, Serbs as Romanian.

ZA.name: South Africa
ZA.notes: The South African value is itself a wide mix.

ZM.name: Zambia
ZM.notes: Central and southern Bantu peoples are drawn as the nearest listed neighbors.
